newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bank of France injects 100 mln Ffr at tender.
newsitem.headline: Bank of France injects 100 mln Ffr at tender.

text.p: The Bank of France injected 100 million francs at a securities repurchase tender held on Monday to allocate funds for injection into the money market on Tuesday.
It accepted bids for 39.0 billion francs in new liquidity, 100 million more than the 38.9 billion leaving the market on Tuesday when a previous pact expires. The new pact expires on March 25.
The Bank of France said it allocated 11.5 billion francs to bidders offering Treasury bills as collateral, satisfying 3.6 percent of such demand.
It allotted a further 27.5 billion to bidders putting up private paper, satisfying 11.3 percent of this demand.
